scripts.dev:local: docker compose up -d --wait api sandbox && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:py && pnpm schema:check
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs api ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs api ruff format --check . && node scripts/py.mjs sandbox ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs sandbox ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/py.mjs api ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs sandbox ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && node scripts/py.mjs api mypy && node scripts/py.mjs sandbox mypy
scripts.test:api: node scripts/py.mjs api pytest && node scripts/py.mjs sandbox pytest
scripts.schema:gen: pnpm --filter @arena/schema gen && node scripts/py.mjs api python scripts/gen_schema.py
scripts.schema:check: pnpm --filter @arena/schema check && node scripts/py.mjs api python scripts/gen_schema.py --check
